items.text:
A character's story should grow beyond its first canvas.

At Soulidity Labs, we're building Animacraft for character creation and Soulidity for identity, content and permissions on Sui.

Create Once. Live Across Worlds.

More demos and development updates here.
items.verification: Chrome X profile displayed matching full text, account @MaximusSega, post URL and profile count 46.

items.text:
Your original character can have art, a backstory, outfits and years of memories. Keeping them connected is part of the creative work.

That's the problem we're working on at Soulidity Labs.

What is hardest to manage as your character grows?
items.claim_scope: Problem framing and research question; no measured prevalence claim.

items.text:
One character-making tool, many possible characters.

In Animacraft, creators define the layers, styles, colors and composition rules of a reusable Maker.

We're building for artists who want to share a creative system as well as a finished image.
items.claim_scope: Explain confirmed Maker concept; do not imply the entire publishing journey is release-ready.

items.text:
A character's identity and its files solve different problems.

Soulidity is designed to connect a persistent Soul identity with versioned content and explicit permissions.

The aim: keep developing the same character as its story, appearance and uses grow.
items.claim_scope: Architecture and design intent, not a completed interoperability claim.

items.text:
Owning a character, accessing its content and holding a copyright license are different rights.

We're designing Soulidity to express those differences clearly.

Creators should be able to tell people what they can use, and under which conditions.
items.claim_scope: Product design, not legal advice or an assertion that blockchain determines copyright.

items.text:
Where would you want your original character to live next?

On your desktop? In a game? Alongside an AI agent workflow?

SoulDesk and our game projects explore those directions. We're developing each use case separately around the broader Soulidity ecosystem.
items.claim_scope: SoulDesk and games remain development directions; no universal runtime compatibility.

items.text:
Our current engineering focus is Sui.

The Soulidity design uses onchain identity and permissions, Walrus for content, and Seal for conditional access. Editing and rendering happen in clients.

Each layer has a clear job in the character lifecycle.
items.claim_scope: Architecture scope; recheck network/config before release; no Solana/Sonic production claim.
